S1.name: Original two-note signature
S1.desc: Unchanged reference: D5 rising to A5 on the settle.

S2d.name: Refined two-note signature
S2d.desc: The same rising D5 to A5, warmer and cleaner; the reflection follows the arrival note.

S2e.name: Refined two-note signature
S2e.desc: The same rising D5 to A5, warmer and cleaner; the reflection follows the arrival note.

S3d.name: Rising sonar sweep (C1)
S3d.desc: One clean rising sweep onto A5; the reflection is of the ring after it lands, never the sweep itself.

S3e.name: Rising sonar sweep (C1)
S3e.desc: One clean rising sweep onto A5; the reflection is of the ring after it lands, never the sweep itself.

S4d.name: Sonar-musical hybrid
S4d.desc: A rounded sonar ping on A5, then a soft tonal resolution that locks onto D6 on the settle; the reflection follows the resolution.

S4e.name: Sonar-musical hybrid
S4e.desc: A rounded sonar ping on A5, then a soft tonal resolution that locks onto D6 on the settle; the reflection follows the resolution.
